---
title: "`r params$title`"
output: word_document
params:
  data: NULL
  title: "Table"
  footnotes: NULL
---

```{r table, echo = FALSE}
knitr::kable(params$data)
```

```{r footnotes, echo = FALSE, results = "asis"}
if (length(params$footnotes) > 0) {
  cat(paste(params$footnotes, collapse = "\n\n"))
}
```
